findings.evidence: To subscribe to our daily digital newsletter and updates bulletin, users are required to complete their profile by providing their full national identity card number, marital status, exact number of household dependents, and current employer details alongside their preferred email address.

While specific technical details concerning our data categorization, exact collection vectors, and internal retention schedules are proprietary and generally remain confidential, registered users may submit a formal written inquiry to our administrative office to request a summary of these parameters following the completion of their account creation.
